purpose: Parallel source-first feasibility wave using public administrative, scientific and infrastructure event channels with independent clocks.

candidates.name: Clinical-trial result/publication state × pharma exposure
candidates.hypothesis: Newly public clinical-trial result or protocol-state changes may create an information state for exposed issuers distinct from price-derived signals.
candidates.construction: Fixed event taxonomy from ClinicalTrials.gov first-posted, last-update-posted and results-first-posted fields; issuer exposure graph frozen before observation; only information posted by the decision cutoff may enter the state.
candidates.next_gate: historical API/archive coverage, first-posted date semantics, revision lineage, sponsor-to-issuer mapping

candidates.name: Vehicle recall campaign shock × automotive exposure
candidates.hypothesis: Newly published safety recalls may create an operational/regulatory shock for manufacturers and suppliers before prices fully incorporate the information.
candidates.construction: Fixed NHTSA recall campaign taxonomy using published recall dates and campaign identifiers; exposure graph frozen from disclosed vehicle/product relationships; later database revisions cannot rewrite earlier states.
candidates.next_gate: historical completeness, recall-publication clock, campaign amendment handling, product-to-issuer mapping

candidates.name: Workplace-safety enforcement shock × industrial exposure
candidates.hypothesis: Newly public OSHA inspections/citations may reveal operational or compliance shocks affecting exposed issuers.
candidates.construction: Fixed OSHA inspection/citation event classes; establishment-to-issuer mapping frozen ex ante; observation date and public dissemination boundary must be separated from incident/inspection dates.
candidates.next_gate: historical release/availability reconstruction, establishment identity coverage, citation revision semantics

candidates.name: FERC regulatory filing/order state × utility exposure
candidates.hypothesis: Publicly issued or received FERC regulatory documents may contain utility-specific information not reducible to market-price history.
candidates.construction: Fixed FERC document/event taxonomy using eLibrary issue/receive records; issuer/facility exposure graph frozen before the decision period; later document corrections remain separate events.
candidates.next_gate: free-source route, issue/receive clock, archive completeness, issuer/facility mapping

candidates.name: Transportation incident publication shock × operator exposure
candidates.hypothesis: Public NTSB accident/investigation publication states may transmit operational information to transportation issuers independently of broad news sentiment.
candidates.construction: Fixed NTSB incident-state taxonomy from official accident/investigation records and publication reports; origin/event time is not substituted for public observation time; operator exposure is frozen.
candidates.next_gate: historical archive coverage, public publication boundary, duplicate/correction handling, operator mapping

candidates.name: FCC licensing transaction state × communications exposure
candidates.hypothesis: Newly public FCC license/application transactions may encode changes in communications infrastructure exposure before broad market repricing.
candidates.construction: Fixed FCC ULS transaction taxonomy using public daily transaction files; application/license identity and transaction date are distinct from file-publication availability; issuer/licensee mapping is frozen ex ante.
candidates.next_gate: daily-file history, dissemination boundary, transaction/amendment semantics, licensee/issuer mapping
